dataset: sklearn.make_classification: n=5000, features=20, informative=5, redundant=5, weights=[0.8,0.2], class_sep=1.0, random_state=seed
split: stratified 60/20/20; first split random_state=seed, second split random_state=seed+1
primary_metric: mean average precision over held-out clean, MCAR 10%, 30%, and 50% conditions; average conditions within seed then seeds equally
control: median-imputed HistGradientBoostingClassifier, 100 iterations, 15 leaves, min_samples_leaf=20, L2=1; no mask columns or augmentation
candidate: same HGB capacity, median frozen from training; cumulative clean + 10% + 30% train-only masked copies; mask columns scaled by training-only mutual information divided by its mean
validation_selection: 30% selected by highest weighted-candidate mean AP over all seeds and validation conditions; validation means 30%=0.8640261, 50%=0.8640781, a negligible difference; 30% frozen as the deployment-rate setting after effectively tied score
ablations: elevated-rate augmentation without the 10% curriculum phase
pass_rule: supported_pilot only if candidate mean AP exceeds control and paired mean difference is positive in all three seeds; otherwise no_gain or inconclusive depending on failures/variance
corruption: same deterministic MCAR mask seed for all methods within each seed and condition; rates 0, .10, .30, .50
limitations: HistGradientBoosting does not support safe incremental fitting across changing datasets; phases are cumulative augmentation strata in the final fit, not sequential optimizer updates. Synthetic MCAR only.
procedural_deviation: The configuration and decision rule were fixed after validation and before final execution, but a path error caused the preregistration JSON to be written after the final command had executed. Final metrics were not inspected until after the JSON was written. This is not a strict preregistration-before-execution; treat the test as exploratory.
